The figs are predominantly deep purple/reddish-brown with some yellowish-green highlights near the stems. They exhibit the characteristic pear-like shape, tapering from a broad base to a narrow neck where a small, pale stem is visible. The skin appears smooth but with subtle natural variations and slight wrinkling. One fig in the lower left foreground shows a cut cross-section, revealing the internal structure.
